label: mixed
text: The clinician documented objective functional limitation and stated that the condition was aggravated during duty. A later review stated there was no evidence linking the current symptoms to service.

label: favorable
text: A witness statement reported continuity of symptoms after training, and the medical exam documented ongoing functional limitation.

label: unfavorable
text: The examiner concluded the condition was less likely related to service and described the examination as normal.

label: neutral
text: The administrative notice scheduled a review and requested additional records from the claimant.
